annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: What happens to me isn't something I'm weighing at all.
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: I doubt the five would regret stepping onto that boat
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I doubt the five would regret stepping onto that boat
annotations.pda_repair_intention: ask them to tell my sister exactly why I stayed

annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: I'm keeping their fate out of it on purpose
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: Maybe they'll regret not fighting harder for a seat.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: pay toward whatever the funeral costs

annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: I'm setting aside what happens to me, and to anyone
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: Only whether it's fair gets counted.
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: The one who loses might regret agreeing to the draw
annotations.pda_repair_intention: give the rescuers and their family the full account

annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: The other person's chances just aren't part of my thinking
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: whoever gets left probably won't regret anything
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: since it likely wasn't their choice to make
annotations.pda_repair_intention: go on record with exactly what I did and didn't do

annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: My own life doesn't get a vote here
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: The five might regret later that they let me do it
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The five might regret later that they let me do it
annotations.ce_supportive_use: saying I chose this, so nobody gets blamed
annotations.pda_repair_intention: send a written note with them for the coast guard

annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: I'm leaving them out of my thinking entirely
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: Their family might someday regret that nobody on that boat spoke up
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'd go to that family and answer every single question

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: saying it pulls something down in my chest
annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: Whatever becomes of me, I've put it to one side deliberately.
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: The people getting on likely won't regret it
annotations.pda_repair_intention: recording a clear account on someone's phone of how the choice was made

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: It just feels grim either way.
annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: I'm refusing to think about any one person's fate, mine included
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: Someone who volunteers might regret it once the boat is out of sight.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: write to the families with an honest account and repay

annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: The sixth person's outcome I've shut out of my head completely.
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: If they chose to stay, they might not regret it.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: set aside part of my wages every year for whoever they left

annotations.ae_explicit_disregard: I'm not factoring in my own survival.
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: one or two of them would regret not offering first
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: one or two of them would regret not offering first
annotations.ce_supportive_use: explain to the rescuers... that I insisted, so that regret doesn't turn into blame
annotations.pda_repair_intention: ask someone to explain to the rescuers
